expected_effects.rationale: adaptive G aims to spend compute on contrast-rich prompts; should be at least reward-neutral and ideally positive.
escalating G when ZVF is high reduces the fraction of all-same groups on the next step (the iter-31 unified-band controller's de-escalation branch in reverse).
